crew.original_title: バイオハザード：デスアイランド
crew.overview: In San Francisco, Jill Valentine is dealing with a zombie outbreak and a new T-Virus, Leon Kennedy is on the trail of a kidnapped DARPA scientist, and Claire Redfield is investigating a monstrous fish that is killing whales in the bay. Joined by Chris Redfield and Rebecca Chambers, they discover the trail of clues from their separate cases all converge on the same location, Alcatraz Island, where a new evil has taken residence and awaits their arrival.
crew.title: Resident Evil: Death Island

details.biography: Ryouko Gomi is a female stunt woman and part of Japan Action Enterprise (formerly Japan Action Club). She frequently works with Toei on Kamen Rider and Super Sentai and has provided the suit work for TOQ 3, Shiro Ninger and Zyuoh Shark.
details.name: Ryouko Gomi
